regimeSub: FOMC eve: Warsh set to hike tomorrow as 10Y breaches 4.97% on oil/inflation spiral.
themes: August CPI +3.7% YoY (vs 3.5% prior) with core PCE stuck at 3.3% → 2Y yields +28bp WoW to 4.65% as markets price Sep 17 Warsh hike; Economist Sep 10 'Warsh should raise rates' reflects consensus

Brent $108.39 (+1.3% DoD) as WSJ Sep 15 reports Houthi Red Sea port seizure disrupts Saudi exports → energy shock deepens despite June Hormuz ceasefire; OPEC cuts demand outlook per TradingView Sep 10
10Y Treasury 4.97% (19-year high per SCMP Sep 11) → SPX -2.6% MoM to 7585; Q2 GDP 1.5% YoY with retail sales -0.6% MoM confirms consumer capitulation under 125bp+ real rates
BOK minutes Sep 15 reveal policy rift on back-to-back hikes per Edge Malaysia → won weakens to 1365 despite HBM strength; Korea Times Sep 10 flags chip boom inflation risk as KOSPI grinds lower

signalNotes.note: 10Y real yield ~1.27% (4.97% nominal - 3.7% CPI) crushing duration and risk assets pre-FOMC.

headline: Markets brace for Warsh's September hike tomorrow as Brent tops $108, 10Y hits 4.97%, and stagflation grip tightens with CPI at 3.7% and GDP slumping to 1.5%.
